answer: A fake reputation slot farm hits its nadir when the stake cost exceeds any reward, since sybil accounts must outspend honest ones to climb. Sybil resistance here uses staked epoch commitments: each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified peer attestations. Attestation diversity acts as a prism, splitting one operator's many wallets into distinguishable light. Like footprints shifting on a dune, each new identity erodes the attacker's capital, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
